19	// gitHubHTTPSRe / gitHubSSHRe / gitHubBareRe parse the GitHub URL shapes
20	// `mirror create`/`remove` accept, mirroring the standalone entiredb CLI:
21	//
22	//	https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>(.git)
23	//	git@github.com:<owner>/<repo>(.git)
24	//	(github.com/)<owner>/<repo>
25	//
26	// owner/repo are lowercased so the synthesised /gh/<owner>/<repo> slug
27	// matches what the server persists.
28	//
29	// The owner/repo capture groups are restricted to GitHub's real identifier
30	// charset rather than a permissive "anything but slash". owner/repo flow
31	// unescaped into the STS audience (auth.RepoScopedToken) and the smart-HTTP
32	// probe URL (waitForMirrorClone); a loose pattern would admit ?, #, %, .. and
33	// control chars, letting a name like `repo?bypass=1` smuggle a query string
34	// or `repo#x` truncate the path. GitHub owners are [A-Za-z0-9-] and repos are
35	// [A-Za-z0-9._-], so matching upstream reality closes those vectors at the
36	// boundary instead of relying on whatever the server does with weird strings.
37	const (
38		gitHubOwnerPat = `([A-Za-z0-9-]+)`
39		gitHubRepoPat  = `([A-Za-z0-9._-]+?)`
40	)
41	
42	var (
43		gitHubHTTPSRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^https?://github\.com/` + gitHubOwnerPat + `/` + gitHubRepoPat + `(?:\.git)?$`)
44		gitHubSSHRe   = regexp.MustCompile(`^git@github\.com:` + gitHubOwnerPat + `/` + gitHubRepoPat + `(?:\.git)?$`)
45		gitHubBareRe  = regexp.MustCompile(`^(?:github\.com/)?` + gitHubOwnerPat + `/` + gitHubRepoPat + `(?:\.git)?$`)

47		// gitHubDotOnlyRe matches repo segments that are entirely dots
48		// (".", "..", ...). The tightened owner charset already excludes

50		// embed a literal ".." in both /gh/<owner>/<repo> and the
51		// token-exchange audience. Reject at the boundary.
52		gitHubDotOnlyRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^\.+$`)
53	)
